prompts:
Edit the supplied background illustration. Keep the exact 16:9 framing, wall/table junction at 64% image height, cool blue palette, all stationery positions and sizes, blank central working area, and preserve the notebook's existing optical ray diagrams and arrow directions. Regenerate surface finish and lighting.
Make a polished quiet educational science illustration with shallow painted dimensionality, broad color fields and delicate uniform printed-paper grain.
Add clearly visible but soft ambient occlusion: a narrow deep navy contact shadow at the wall/table seam softly spreading onto both adjoining planes; natural layered contact shadows beneath notebook page stacks, pencil, eraser and right notebook; gentle broad corner darkening, brighter center. The wall and tabletop should now feel spatially separated. Keep usable central area clear and moderately lit, no black crushed corners.
Completely replace the irregular embossed swirly texture. Table is smooth matte slate-blue painted paper with extremely fine EVEN isotropic speckles, no grooves, cracks, scribbles, raised bumps or marble. Wall is smooth navy with a mathematically regular orthogonal square grid: straight thin equally spaced horizontal and vertical lines, consistent low contrast, no double lines, no broken or wobbly cells, no patchy texture. Grid remains subtly visible into shadow. Soft artistic light from upper left, restrained blue reflected light.
Preserve illustrated simplified stationery and exact scientific diagram content. No new equipment, rail, mirrors, titles, controls, labels, borders or additional objects. Full bleed opaque background. This is an asset background, not a finished UI.

Edit this image, preserve composition, stationery, all notebook diagram strokes, regular wall grid, ambient occlusion and color palette. REPAINT THE ENTIRE BLUE TABLETOP SURFACE as a smooth airbrushed matte blue plane with exceptionally fine uniform film grain. The current tabletop has dense squiggly worms and crumpled relief texture: REMOVE ALL of that texture entirely. Use smooth soft large gradients, absolutely no visible patterned marks or squiggles. Fine grain must be tiny dustlike pixels, barely visible. Also smooth the wall to the same micrograin while keeping its perfectly regular grid. Preserve and strengthen soft contact shadows at wall/table junction and underneath stationery. Maintain subdued illustrated style, 16:9. No new objects or text.
